answer: Transaction-Graph Motif Scoring. Score each identity by how often it appears in recurring small subgraphs (A→B→C→A triangles) with otherwise low-activity neighbors, weighted against a baseline sonnet of normal trade motifs. Post-hoc, flag clusters whose motif profile deviates sharply; freeze their payouts pending review. An attacker must sustain plausible triangle patterns across many accounts for weeks, paying real fees and latency per edge, plus the ledge of frozen funds during review. Honest comets of activity clear quickly; farms don't.
